::: {#def-hidden-layer}

#### Hidden layer

A **hidden layer** of a network is a vector that the network computes from its input
on the way to its output,
and that is neither the input nor the output [@goodfellow2016deep, Ch. 6].

The [training data](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/anatomy.html#def-training-data) give an input and a target output for each example,
but no target for a hidden layer:
training chooses the [parameters](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter) that compute it.
These notes write a hidden layer as $\vhidval$.

:::
